The people were very nice & fast.
And the building was super clean .

We are incredibly pleased with the OUTSTANDING   🏆🥇🏆 care & precise surgical expertise given to our rescues & pets at KAAWS. All staff & veterinarians are beyond amazing!!! Staff is extremely thorough with processing wellness visits & surgical appointments. The small surgical incisions (Dr. Bazan) for spay/neuter surgeries are the BEST we have ever experienced & that says a  lot with over 35 years of spay/neuter surgeries!!!!!
We appreciate the cost effective measures KAAWS   provides to end the needless suffering in Houston & surrounding areas. Forever grateful for KAAWS!!!
THANK YOU ALL!!!🏆🥇🏆
Excellent service!!
Wonderful staff. Affordable prices. Great service.

All staff have been a great help to us and our pup! Came in with lab work that was from another vet who was trying to gauge us on neutering and other procedures and KAAWS took us in right away and offered better service, for a more reasonable price. Even post-op, the team has been very communicative and open to answering all our questions and concerns. Couldn't recommend more!

I have brought two female cats to be spayed ant KAAWS on 529. Both came back completely traumatized. They were perfectly fine, normal cats, one of them had experienced surgery as a kitten due to needing a leg removed and she was perfectly fine and healed, they were both normal. Immediately after the surgery they started behaving EXTREMELY afraid of humans. Literally PETRIFIED of humans. They are afraid ALL of the time. I don’t know what happened to them during the spay surgery. Whatever it was definitely happened at this clinic. I have many cats and only the ones I brought to this place are traumatized. It’s been years since they were spayed and they still won’t go ANYWHERE near humans. We often go weeks without seeing them because they will do anything to avoid us. At first we thought it could just be post surgery anxiety, or maybe they were afraid of us for taking them to the vet, or maybe the experience of surgery. We hoped that with time they would learn to trust us again but they were never the same again. If a human walks in a room where they are, they lose their minds and will FLY away immediately as if they are being actively chased/hunted. They are completely traumatized and anxious. It’s heartbreaking to watch and there is nothing I can do because they won’t let ANYONE near them😭 I live with anxiety praying that they don’t get sick because it would be impossible to get them to a vet or give them medications. Like I said I waited years before making this review in the hopes that it was just the surgery and that with time they would trust us again but that never happened. I regret bringing them there. PLEASE consider my experience. Take your babies elsewhere if possible. The empty shelter project is 100% FREE and they have helped the community tremendously. I volunteer for them often and they are amazing people. They genuinely love animals, I have personally seen how dedicated they are. Every single person who volunteers for them treats ALL animals with love and respect. I have worked in the medical field and have experience with infection control. They are VERY clean, efficient, well organized, professional, and truly care about their little patients. I’ve taken over 20 cats to them for spay/neuter and have sent many pet owners to them. I have also used other clinics before I learned about them. I have never had an issue anywhere else. I don’t know what happened to these two girl cats at this KAAWS clinic but I don’t think they will ever recover from it. I’m not writing this to bash KAAWS, I did bring two male cats to another location for neuter surgery and they were both okay. The 529 location is where my two traumatized cats went to 😔 I’m heartbroken. I feel like this is my fault for bringing them there 😔 here are pictures of them before the surgeries. 🥺

Great staff, very helpful and the staff there, truly care about the health and well-being of my cat and always takes the time to explain everything, I never feel rushed.     Highly recommended.   I have been taking my cat there for the past 10 years and received nothing but OUTSTANDING care.
Genuinely such a good vet, very honest and always polite!

It was a 45 minute wait to check in just like the paperwork said it might. The check in itself was quick and thorough. The clinic was clean and the staff very professional. My dog went in for a neuter. A week later my dog is his old self. The surgical area on the dog looks great! I would recommend this clinic.
Been going since 2020 and the staff continues to be friendly and informative. Dental and medicine are the only expenses that are pricey but when are they not for humans or animals alike.
Price is reasonable and good location. They are not pushy like the other Vet Clinic.

These people are always kind, understanding, so informative and the prices are so reasonable.   This is my second time with them.  I have 1 momma with 2 babies.  Momma was spayed and a baby was neutered yesterday.   I just really like these people.  They are organized, on time, and have suggestions to help with the health of your pet.  I appreciate ALL they do and say.  I recommend them to the highest!  So thankful for them.
Very nice facility.
Efficient, affordable and courteous
Nicest vet and so knowledgeable. She answered all my questions and concerns.
Very pleased with my visit, very nice friendly and very informative about everything with my cat. Coming back to spay my baby soon.

I thoroughly enjoyed the appointment-based system at this clinic. On both visits, I was seen within 5 to 10 minutes of my appointment. The clinic is relatively quiet, with only a few other animals present at any given time. The service and employees are exceptional, and the doctor was incredibly knowledgeable. Overall, I had a wonderful experience.
Kind, caring and affordable. Thank you everyone. Y’all are awesome.
I love this place.  Rudy went in for one of his shots.  He's such a good boy!!!
Great service, their services are affordable and they are very thorough in their exams and recommendations.

My two puppies came for their one year visit. And their annual package saved me money compared to my local vet. I will come back and this will be my permanent vet for my puppies. This place was recommended by a friend and I would like to do the same to anyone who would consider going here. I trust this place.
They were amazing handling my kitties needs.  He went in for a neuter. Process was simple. I do think on pricing they could be a bit more clear when services are offered.

Great people.
Great prices.
Highly recommend
I love KAAWS Clinic on 529.  They provide excellent care, maintain timely appointments, and the vets are amazing.

Very attentive and friendly staff. It was our first visit but my dog must have felt like a celebrity from all the attention and care! 🐶
And his diarrhea issue was resolved ✌️ …
Staff was extremely friendly and the prices are are good. Took great car of our cat.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 5-Star Review for KAAWS Veterinary Clinic

The entire team is professional, knowledgeable, compassionate, and genuinely cares about both their patients and the pet parents. What I appreciate most is that KAAWS is a wonderful, well-rounded veterinary clinic that provides quality care at very reasonable prices. I’m so thankful for their team and highly recommend KAAWS to anyone looking for affordable, reliable, and compassionate veterinary care! 🐾❤️
Great place, always Professional and Friendly, been going to KAAWS for years. Highly recommend them.
Excellent experience!!
Always a great experience when I come here and my Zoë Marie was in great hands. Thanks Ladies 🥰🤗 …
I REALLY LOVE THE STAFF THERE AND SO DOES MY FURBABY GIRL DIOR. THEY ARE SO NICE AND VERY PROFESSIONAL. THEY ALWAYS TAKE VERY GOOD CARE OF HER.

Kaaws is very professional facility. From the time I came in and dropped off my female dog (Jessie). To letting me know everything went well and she was in recovery. To the time I pick up my female dog. I will be bringing my male dog (Ray) up in the next two days. Thank you everyone at Kaaws!!!!
The other paw parents, staff and vets are so kind and supportive.
I took my dog Cashmere to get her nails trimmed and they did an awesome job! They loved on her and she came out so happy with her freshly trimmed nails.

Surgery was  a success n the incision looks perfect. Very great price n there's a discount for that day too...perfect. All staff were friendly, courteous n knowledgeable. I would strongly recommend this clinic. Love most is communication...dont need to call but can text them.Very quick response.Thank you.

Just got another baby fixed/ neutered yesterday.
All staff very friendly n courteous.
Price very affordable...will strongly recommend Kaaws.  Will be seeing them again probably in 6 mths time to get my female puppy fix.
Thank you.
They did a good job neutering my cat. No problems.

Brought my cat in last Thursday bc I noticed he urinated crystal and was having trouble to relieve himself. The initial plan was to run a urinalysis and prescribe meds, but upon examination doctor found his bladder was very full and he was most likely having a blockage. They weren’t able to do the procedure so they skipped the urinalysis and referred me to a full-service clinic instead. They didn’t charge me anything for the exam, as the vet explained that I would have to undergo exams and tests at the new location all over again so I wouldn’t have to pay twice! Thanks to this I was able to save some money and got my baby the urinary catheterization procedure he needed.
Very easy process .  Quick and easy drop off .  Great service I would recommend them .
Wonderful, caring, and detailed communication regarding your pet,  and accommodating vet and staff. Thank you for all that you do!! ❤️ Andy, Heart, and KarlPatitas
Impressive service and very kind staff! Will be back for spay/neutering the rest of my pack.
Great experience. Got my cat neutered and the incision is small and nest. My cat is not in discomfort and is using the bathroom normally. Thank you guys !
Always very polite, Receptionists. Never have along wait. Assistant very polite and Vet also. Vet.is very informative of my Dog condition.  Prices reasonable too!
I ABSOLUTELY LOVE AND RECOMMEND KAWWS TO ANY AND EVERYONE
Great doctors! Great service. Hard to talk to a human on the phone.

Did great jobs on both our babies. GSD and Mastiff had their surgeries yesterday of spay and neuter. First night is always a little rough but they were so informative and helpful. We were set up every item  we would need. I highly recommend Kaaws for your needs.
Reasonable pricing.

We had our newest baby spayed here & it was absolutely amazing. So easy to check in & pick up. The staff is so caring & compassionate. We had never left her before & they were so gentle with her. She is doing amazing & we are so greatful for this place. The price was amazing! We paid 220.00 total for spay, rabies,nail trim & microchip. We were quoted 800+ from our vet. Plus we got meds to take home.our baby is a female cat & she weighs 6.5. Lbs & is 9 months old. Vanillaphee is doing fantastic! Thank y’all so much

Nail appointment no issues with my cat
We love KAAWS!  They have wonderful people, from the front desk to the techs and doctors, who go above and beyond to provide excellent service at very fair prices!
Staff very kindly

They kept us updated throughout the process and made sure she was comfortable during recovery. I can’t thank them enough for taking such wonderful care of our fur baby. Highly recommend!
My go to for spaying and vaccinations. Friendly and professional staff always acts with compassion.
KAAWS Clinic is fantastic! Making appointments is very easy, the wait times are short, and the vets are super kind and caring.

Our experience was awesome at The Kaaws clinic.  Veronica Rozelle was very attentive and helped us right away. Our dog Lady needed her shots updated and we were concerned about her having allergies.  Veronica got us an appointment right away. She was caring and asked detailed questions about Lady. Our technician Raquel was very patient with lady and took her time. She made sure lady felt comfortable. Lady had a wonderful visit. Thank you and your team.

Friendly staff, fast responses, and quick spay surgery for our girl, Dixie!

Also, unbeatable pricing.

I’ve had such a great experience with this veterinary clinic! The entire staff is warm, welcoming, and truly cares about the animals they treat. They always take the time to answer my questions, explain everything clearly, and make my dog feel safe and comfortable. You can tell they genuinely love what they do. Appointments run on time, the clinic is always clean, and their follow-up after visits shows how much they care. I trust them with my fur baby’s health!

Very pleasant. Tech was knowledgeable, friendly & caring.
Dr was great. She thoroughly examined my fur baby. Explained & answered questions. She was sweet & very caring.
I would highly recommend to everyone.

I have also taken my dogs and other cats there for spay and neuter procedures, and I have always been satisfied with their service. It is a great place, and I would definitely recommend it to others.
Excellent service. Clean facility. Everything went smoothly.
Checking was easy. Curbside. Pick up equally easy.  Dig is doing well

They run things a little different than most vets i have been to. Although different, I found it efficient and easy on my pet. The staff was friendly and knew their jobs well. I mention that because it is of great importance to me. I would recommend them for the same services my pretty received.

Our cat is a indoor cat and he had never had fleas before. Its been a hard 2 weeks for all in the house. They should have a better control of fleas in the clinic. I really doubt we are taking him back there after this experience.
On time. Affordable super nice. We will be going back.
I took my dog to get neutered. I was a little nervous at first, but after I arrived and met the staff that quickly went away. Everyone was so nice and the office was very clean. Thank you 🙏

I guess other people have had ok experiences, and it seems the actual procedure went as it was supposed to buuuuut...would it hurt for anybody to smile or be remotely friendly??? And we needed blood work prior to the procedure. When I called to ask ahead of making an appt if bloodwork is part of the procedure cost, I was told yes, only to find out once we're in the room to drop him off I was told it costs extra...oh and, when the wait time for a drop off is 45 mins to an hour, you really need to let people know that BEFORE the appointment, not via text after they're there and already waiting in the car for 30 mins. People need to plan around that kind of wait time! Super annoying frustrating experience all around!
Wonderful establishment. I have taken my pets here for years, especially for surgery. Would highly recommend.
